name: RestockMonitor
short: Free Pokémon card restock alerts for Target, Best Buy, Walmart, Shopify card shops and more.
description: Watches product links at Target, Best Buy, Walmart, GameStop, Pokémon Center, Amazon, any Shopify card shop and most other stores — plus whole Shopify shops for new or restocked items matching keywords. Posts an alert with a Buy button and your chosen ping the moment something goes from sold out to available. Uses only free, public store data — no paid APIs.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores product links, store links and alert settings per server, plus the Discord user ID of whoever added each link. It does not store message content.
author: aKidWolfe96
install_msg:
Restock Monitor installed!

Get started:
1. `[p]restock channel #restocks`
2. `[p]restock ping @Collectors` (or everyone / here / none)
3. `[p]restock add <product link>`
4. `[p]restock store add <shopify shop link> pokemon` to watch a whole card shop

`[p]restock retailers` lists supported stores. If you used BestBuyMonitor, its products are imported automatically.
